scope: Primary-source metadata and original notices for 15 benchmark tasks; not a blanket license of the assembled collection.
dataset_adaptations: Fixed class subsets, orientation/polarity corrections where documented, exact-native-image curation, grayscale conversion for RGB, and float32 9x9 area resizing.
uncertain_license_policy: null means no standard license was established from the primary source; it does not mean public domain or unrestricted reuse. Public availability and citation alone are not asserted to grant redistribution rights.

kuzushiji.name: Kuzushiji-MNIST and Kuzushiji-49
kuzushiji.attribution: "KMNIST Dataset" (created by CODH), adapted from "Kuzushiji Dataset" (created by NIJL and others), doi:10.20676/00000341
kuzushiji.notes: The creator explicitly applies CC BY-SA 4.0 to both the dataset and repository. Our class selection, deduplication and 9x9 area-averaged images are adaptations, distributed under the same license.
kuzushiji.citation: Clanuwat, T., Bober-Irizar, M., Kitamoto, A., Lamb, A., Yamamoto, K., and Ha, D. (2018). Deep Learning for Classical Japanese Literature. arXiv:1812.01718.

emnist.name: EMNIST
emnist.notes: The university data record marks access Open and license Other license, with copyright Western Sydney University. The NIST-hosted README does not state a standard license. NIST hosting and SD19 provenance do not establish that this derivative release is public domain; no SPDX license is inferred.
emnist.citation: Cohen, G., Afshar, S., Tapson, J., and van Schaik, A. (2017). EMNIST: an extension of MNIST to handwritten letters. Western Sydney University.

devanagari.name: Devanagari Handwritten Character Dataset
devanagari.attribution: Shailesh Acharya and Prashnna Gyawali, Devanagari Handwritten Character Dataset (2015), UCI Machine Learning Repository, doi:10.24432/C5XS53.
devanagari.notes: The UCI record explicitly licenses sharing and adaptation under CC BY 4.0. This suite selects only digit_0 through digit_9 and resizes their images.

madbase.name: MADBase
madbase.attribution: Sherif Abdelazeem and Ezzat El-Sherif, The Arabic Handwritten Digits Databases: ADBase & MADBase, The American University in Cairo.
madbase.notes: The creators publicly provide download links and describe digit-recognition research use. No standard license or explicit redistribution grant was located on the primary page; no license from a third-party mirror is substituted.
madbase.citation: Abdelazeem, S., and El-Sherif, E. The Arabic Handwritten Digits Databases: ADBase & MADBase. The American University in Cairo.

notmnist.name: notMNIST
notmnist.notes: The creator provides the archives publicly for experimentation. No standard dataset license was found on the original announcement. Font images are rendered, not handwriting. No third-party mirror license is substituted.

svhn.name: Street View House Numbers (SVHN)
svhn.attribution: Yuval Netzer, Tao Wang, Adam Coates, Alessandro Bissacco, Bo Wu, and Andrew Y. Ng, Reading Digits in Natural Images with Unsupervised Feature Learning (2011).
svhn.notes: The primary download page explicitly attaches non-commercial use to both full-number and cropped-digit formats. This is a use restriction, not a CC or MIT license. cifar10.name: CIFAR-10
cifar10.attribution: Alex Krizhevsky, Vinod Nair, and Geoffrey Hinton, CIFAR-10.
cifar10.notes: The original dataset page publicly offers the data and requests citation of the technical report. No standard dataset license was located there. In particular, licenses of third-party loaders or mirrors are not asserted to apply to these images.
cifar10.citation: Krizhevsky, A. (2009). Learning Multiple Layers of Features from Tiny Images. University of Toronto technical report.
